reviews.comment:
Servico de playa excelente, mi puntuación es sobre la experiencia de mi Sra y mia, sobre el salon, pedimos 2 empanadas de carne y un sandwich de milanesa completa, la empanada mordí 2 veces, olor a vinagreta, gusto a grasa y el relleno según nos dijeron de carne cortada a cuchillo incomible y el sandwich de milanesa completo ni, dos rodajas de tomate en todo el sandwich, la milanesa plástica y el pan realmente dejo mucho que desear, las empanadas me la reembolsaron y la mila la comimos pero no nos gustó para nada, por favor mejoren la calidad, soy socio de hace mas de 40 años y no coresponde que tengan esa calidad, no es una simple YPF es una sucursal del ACA en un punto importante de la Ruta 2 mitad de camino.

(Translated by Google)
Excellent beach service. My rating is based on my wife's and my experience in the restaurant. We ordered two meat empanadas and a complete milanesa sandwich. I only bit into the empanada twice; it smelled of vinaigrette, tasted greasy, and the filling, which they told us was hand-cut beef, was inedible. The complete milanesa sandwich was awful—just two slices of tomato in the whole sandwich. The milanesa was plasticky, and the bread really left much to be desired. They refunded me for the empanadas, and we ate the milanesa, but we didn't like it at all. Please improve the quality. I've been a member for over 40 years, and it's unacceptable that the quality is this bad. It's not just a YPF gas station; it's an ACA branch at a key point on Route 2, about halfway there.
